mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.5%, signaling a tight labor market, wage pressures increase, leading to higher production costs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY indicates strong supply-side momentum, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window during non-recession periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% MoM signals decreased consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when RSAFS declines > 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL), signaling a hawkish monetary stance, S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window when FEDFUNDS > CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth, as a proxy for labor market health, positively correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation coefficient between PAYEMS growth and SPX 60d returns falls below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth (GDPC1) above 3% YoY, combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 5%), indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window when GDPC1 growth > 3% YoY and UNRATE < 5%.
